candidateToRefine.name: Nami — Art of Weather
candidateToRefine.description: Stationary Straw Hat weather controller, manga continuity through Wano. Implements Clima-Tact lightning, a bounded weather-induced slow, scheduled Heat Egg projectiles, Gust Sword displacement and Raitei. Zeus already resides in the Clima-Tact at placement: Hera seemingly consumes his former body, the weapon speaks, and his survival within it is explained during Wano. No former standalone Zeus body is summoned. A generous lightning collision radius and optional prelaunch retargeting approximate his assistance; true homing, weapon reshaping and consciousness transfer are omitted. Mirage Tempo and Fata Morgana are preserved as omitted optical deception: this encounter has no defensive targeting or evasion, so they grant no fake damage, concealment detection or taunt. Milky Road terrain/travel, showers, Impact Dial absorption/recoil, navigation, theft and financial management are also omitted. Heat/cool weather preparation is compressed into lightning's slowing impact; slowing is a game abstraction, not a claimed canonical debuff. No regeneration denial, healing, ally damage buffs or elemental immunity bypass. All numbers, prices, stamina costs, schedules and tier unlocks are provisional game adaptations, not canon measurements or measured balance. Stamina represents Technique preparation, not transformation exhaustion. Highest purchased tier unlocks Gust Sword at 1 and replaces its button with Raitei at 5 on every path. Purchases are cumulative under the host's maximum 5-2-0 rule. Enemy movement remains caller-supplied. Supplied reference text was reviewed; fresh external research was unavailable, so independent source verification remains outstanding.

paths.name: Thundercloud Output
paths.description: Personal lightning and Technique damage specialization. Heat Egg remains a separate, static scheduled attack and receives none of these purchases. Damage scaling is authored tuning, not new powers or a claim that Raitei defeats every opponent in one hit.

upgrades.name: Charged Weather Balls
upgrades.description: Adds 4 damage to the primary and all Techniques. Highest tier 1 also unlocks stamina and Gust Sword.

upgrades.name: Denser Thundercloud
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by 1.2 after flat additions.

upgrades.name: Larger Charge Reserve
upgrades.description: Adds another 8 damage to the primary and all Techniques; does not change or refill stamina.

upgrades.name: Concentrated Discharge
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by a further 1.3.

upgrades.name: Zeus-Amplified Thunder
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by a further 1.45. Highest tier 5 replaces Gust Sword with Raitei; Zeus was already present in the weapon.

paths.name: Weather Preparation
paths.description: Improves personal weather setup and lightning interruption. Timing reductions represent practiced Clima-Tact preparation, not navigation-based speed magic. Contact stuns are a bounded electrical-interruption abstraction and require both weakWilled and stunnable, respecting active stun and the following protection interval. No purchase improves scheduled Heat Egg.

upgrades.name: Prepared Heat and Cool Mix
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and period by 0.9. Technique timing is unchanged.

upgrades.name: Brief Electrical Interruption
upgrades.description: Eligible primary contacts stun for 0.35 seconds. This does not stun resistant or protected targets.

upgrades.name: Efficient Cloud Assembly
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and period by a further 0.85; does not accelerate Techniques or Heat Egg.

upgrades.name: Sustained Electrical Interruption
upgrades.description: Raises eligible primary contact stun from 0.35 to 0.75 seconds, rather than adding durations.

upgrades.name: Weatheria Setup Mastery
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary timing by a further 0.8 and raises eligible contact stun to 1 second. Tier 5 supplies Raitei through the shared Technique button.

paths.name: Cloud Placement
paths.description: Extends personal acquisition reach and improves prelaunch target handling. Reach is an abstract deployment limit for localized weather, not staff length. Zeus-assisted retargeting replaces one lost primary target only before launch; projectiles never home or retarget after launch, and Techniques never retarget. Mirage Tempo is deliberately not repurposed as detection.

upgrades.name: Extended Cloud Placement
upgrades.description: Adds 4 personal reach, taking the unmodified base reach from 40 to 44.

upgrades.name: Zeus Checks the Target
upgrades.description: Enables one replacement for a lost primary target before launch without restarting windup. No postlaunch steering or Technique retargeting.

upgrades.name: Distant Cloud Positioning
upgrades.description: Adds another 6 personal reach, reaching 50 on this path. Does not change Heat Egg range or projectile speed.

upgrades.name: Stable Long-Range Discharge
upgrades.description: Adds 5 personal reach and 5 damage to the primary and all Techniques.

upgrades.name: Far-Reaching Thundercloud
upgrades.description: Adds 5 personal reach, reaching 60 on this path, and multiplies primary and all Technique damage by 1.25. Tier 5 supplies Raitei; its larger collision tolerance remains an aimed-shot abstraction.

gaps: The supplied pages do not provide the requested game's current contract, supported schema details beyond the output schema, legal path structure, purchase costs, unlock schedules, projectile-flight rules, target geometry, status definitions, or shared-technique lifecycle. A playable implementation cannot be verified against those rules from the supplied evidence.

Any numerical tuning, damage values, ranges, cooldowns, resource costs, status durations, companion behavior, and purchase sequencing would be game adaptations rather than canon facts and require separate disclosure and balancing evidence.

The pages support weather manipulation, lightning, heat, mirages, wind, cloud creation, and Zeus's sentient Clima-Tact integration, but do not establish arbitrary regeneration negation, generic slowing as a canon effect, shields, taunt, healing, or attack-speed magic.

The requested cutoff excludes material after Wano. Source 9523e2588612aa9f0bd5b51f contains later Egghead and Elbaf claims, including attacks against S-Snake, Saturn, and Road; those claims were not used.

The supplied evidence does not establish a complete list of every Nami technique or every limitation through the end of Wano, so unsupported requested features should remain omitted rather than inferred.
